newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tender.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Friday it had passed on tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal due to higher-than-expected prices.
An official at the federation said it would re-invite the tenders by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Tuesday.
Traders said the lowest offer was made by Continental Grain at $279.50 per tonne C&F.
The NLCF official said arrival for the soymeal tender was set by September 30 or October 20 at the ports of Inchon, Kunsan and Ulsan.
Shipment for arrival by September 30 was set for August 25-September 13, if sourced from India or July 28-August 16, if from South America.
Shipment for arrival by October 20 was set for September 14-October 3, if from India or August 17-September 5, if from South America.
